thread:
maya: T-minus 42 mins before change window starts in prod. Quick heads-up — saw a transient embed latency spike on staging ~30m ago, bounded to rwd-embed-v3 quant config. Anyone on-call to double-check before we pin?

tom: on it, looking at datadog now. link: https://app.datadog.com/dash/xyz/embed-p99 (short link)

sre-jon: I see a ~12% tail p99 bump around 12:10, correlated with batching change in canary. Not seeing errors, no increased 5xx. Repro steps?

maya: repro in staging by firing 1k small prompts via loadtest: `./scripts/loadtest --model rwd-embed-v3 --q 1000`. Result: p99 jump. Saved logs: /tmp/embeds-2026-03-21.log

tom: can we rollback canary batching flag? It's behind a config toggle: `BATCHER_BATCH_SIZE=32 -> 16`. I'll flip in sandbox then canary.

deploy-bot: @maya deploy-bot: Pin request created for `rwd-embed-v3` at 1769032100. Current pins: none. Use `/pin approve` to lock version or `/pin abort` to cancel.

product-ash: If we pin, add a short note in release notes about the embed config change. Also propose rollback rule: >=10% p99 increase sustained over 15m -> immediate rollback.

maya: agreed on rollback threshold. Tom, proceed with canary toggle; if spike remains after 3 cycles, we pin rollback and open a hotfix ticket.

tom: toggled canary flag to 16 (canary only). Monitoring now, will report in 5.

sre-jon: FYI set autoscaler minGPU=1 for canary to avoid cold starts during the test. Small tweak applied.

tom: p99 dropping back to baseline after 2 cycles. Looks stable. Recommend no pin and proceed with planned freeze.

maya: thanks. @deploy-bot please proceed with change window start; no pin required. Ash, add note to release notes draft and mark 'monitoring' checklist item complete.

deploy-bot: Change window starting: 1769032560. Canary status: toggles applied. Monitoring heartbeat started. :rocket:

product-ash: noted. Updating release-notes/draft.md: "Reverted canary batch-size experiment due to transient embed p99 spike; monitoring continues." Will push update before EOD.

tom: leaving eyes on graphs for next 60 mins. ping if anything unusual.

maya: closing thread — thanks team. :thumbsup:
